name: POST entries
info:
Routes entries to the correct POST subflow based on target system.

### Input
`msg.entry` = Entry with Metadata

### Logic
- Bridge entry to client converts entry to POST body (uploads Rayvn files inline)
- Switch on `msg.metadata.target.client_system` → POST to Rayvn log or POST to Wasos chat
- After Rayvn POST: checks `entry._failed_files` and emits notification if any failed

### Output 1
Rayvn or WaSOS POST response

### Output 2
Notification payload for Build attachment notification (only when uploads failed)
